title: External validation of a widely available, localizable sepsis early detection model in the emergency department setting
details: D Currey, Y Tarabichi - The American Journal of Emergency Medicine, 2025
abstract: Study objective Several algorithms have been developed to assist clinicians in predicting the onset of sepsis. One of the most widely used is the Epic Sepsis Model. The first release of the model (V1) was a logistic regression that suffered from …
